# Vocalace Course

Vocalace Course is American English course content for Chinese speakers.
One lesson, one point: high-frequency sound errors and American flow (reduction, linking, flap, stress, US wording).
This site is the course content site — not checkout. Practice and pricing live on the main app.
Practice app: https://www.vocalace.com
Price / trial: https://www.vocalace.com/price/
Repo: https://github.com/KenjiGinjo/vocalace-course
Site: https://course.vocalace.com
Contact: hello@vocalace.com
